legend: Determine in how many ways the natural numbers from 1%%ZSMJ0%% to 2n%%ZSMJ1%% can be partitioned into n%%ZSMJ2%% pairs so that in each pair, the second number was at least twice the first
input: The only line of the input contains an integer n%%ZSMJ3%% (1≤n≤25%%ZSMJ4%%).
note: In the example, two valid sets of pairs can be formed: 1 – 5, 2 – 4, 3 – 6 and 1 – 4, 2 – 5, 3 – 6.
